notes: N-318: matchesArtifact must require the element at every codeSepIndexSlots slot to be exactly encodeScriptNumber(codeSepIndex + shift), where shift is the growth (encoded length - 1) of every constructor slot with byteOffset < codeSepIndex, read from the CANDIDATE script, plus that of every earlier (lower byteOffset) codeSep slot with byteOffset < codeSepIndex -- the value RunarContract bakes at deploy. Case fields as fixtures.json; artifact names a key of artifacts. "real" is the TS-compiler output for TaggedLog (stateful, readonly bigint cap, ByteString state log, two public methods; sourceMap/anf dropped) -- two codeSep slots (codeSepIndex 1, baked OP_1) and a constructor slot between them. "shift" is synthetic (stateless) so the baked value depends on a variable-length constructor arg and on the first codeSep slot's expansion. Honest = RunarContract.getLockingScript(); forged = the honest script with only codeSep slot element(s) replaced (code-part length pins re-patched so only the codeSep element differs). Replayed by all 7 SDKs.
